Develop a minimal, checked manual displacement across the boundary, reusing existing surface-work and examination code rather than claiming those mechanisms as inventions. The partial source record is not sufficient to execute now: resolve its complete authoritative state during the existing development handoff and again at execution.\",\"specification\":\"Current-conversation development handoff: implement a bounded manual residue-displacement operation, not general excavation, inventory collection or soil preparation. Proposed interface: start(sourceId, destinationX, destinationY), resume(processId), cancel(processId). Bind this version to sourceId surface-21-lin-113, source circle centered at (9.25,12.9), radius 0.2. Resolve exact live residue entries, coordinates, quantities and revision from that object; do not reconstruct the missing fragment, initialize cover, or treat the stated 0.04 as newly available stock. The request reports tick-23 coverMass=0 and residueMass=0.04, but execution must use live quantities. Bind a separately nominated receiving circle of radius 0.1 whose entire area is outside the source circle and inside bounds [48,36]; center separation must exceed 0.3 and be at most 0.5. No automatic destination selection.\\nPrerequisites: lin alive, individually studied, adequate energy, free usable hands, source and receiver observable and within 0.65 of the actor, and no conflicting work lock. No tool, container, root or consumable is supplied or required for the hand-displacement precursor. Validate a continuous surface-contact route for each supported residue portion to a nominated deposit position inside the receiving circle. Reject unsafe routes through people, plants, obstacles or other reserved work, including swept material extent; exclude only the explicitly targeted source residue from its own collision test. Require actual visible clearance and suitability for hand displacement, not inferred strength, grip, hidden substrate or concealed clearance. If the material cannot be moved by this supported method, finish the examination with an informative blocked result and no movement. A container-dependent transfer is outside this precursor; do not fabricate one.\\nCosts and progress: individual study takes one actual round at 0.2 energy. A valid start takes one examination round at 0.5 energy; at its completion record dated source, destination and route findings. Invalid references or malformed/out-of-range requests do not start or charge. Examination finding no safe feasible route still costs its performed round and records failure. A feasible job permits at most two further active work rounds at 1 energy each, each moving at most 0.02 mass units, total at most min(0.04, actual eligible residue). Thus the initial bounded attempt costs at most three action rounds and 2.5 energy, separately from study. No additional material or energy source is implied. Normal elapsed-round metabolism remains in force.\\nRevalidate reach, source availability, hands, receiver and route before each work round. Use transactional per-round commits with exact source-entry debits and persistent destination deposits in the same commit. Implement the smallest supported surface-contact hand movement, retaining all intermediate displacement if any is physically committed; never teleport residue across an unexamined gap. If intermediate movement cannot be represented safely, permit only complete atomic round transfers along the verified short route. Split a residue entry only by exact supported mass arithmetic. Source remaining mass plus all attributable destination and intermediate deposits must equal the original tracked mass, accounting explicitly for any independently recorded later transfers; no deletion, rounding loss, duplication, inventory conversion or edible/harvestable conversion. Preserve provenance from the original terrain footprint through source-entry and deposit IDs. Existing destination matter is retained and separately accounted for.\\nEach process stores its exact actor, source ID/revision, destination geometry, route, reservations, examination tick, source-entry references, paid rounds, moved mass and remaining allowance. Resume only the same job and unpaid work; never reset a two-round allowance by resuming. Interrupted work retains committed deposits and completed paid progress. Safety invalidation pauses or closes the job without executing unsafe movement. Cancel or death releases only this job's locks, preserving real residue positions; no automatic cleanup, return movement, material duplication or refund of spent energy/time. An uncommitted round makes no material change and charges no unperformed work. A later fresh attempt must examine again and uses actual remaining matter, not initial cover. Resolve competing changes through live revisions and scoped locks, without reserving unrelated terrain or other actors' actions.\\nReport actual moved mass, remaining source residue, exact receiving deposit IDs and positions, intermediate residue if any, work paid, and completed/partial/blocked/cancelled status. Clearing all tracked residue is only a movement result: retain rootCompatible=false or unknown pending a separate supported assessment; never grant planting eligibility, fertility, moisture improvement, food, comfort or mastery. No unattended work or ongoing transport exists. Deposits persist through existing world processes without invented decay, disappearance or maintenance benefits. Any later redistribution or maintenance needs another real action.\\nRecord code dependencies and reuse explicitly: surface accounting and bounded manual displacement from long.surface-preparation / small-soil-patch-preparation@1; examination logic from soil-worksite-assessment where available; existing spatial checks, exact arithmetic, event storage and process interruption/lock infrastructure. Inspect full implementation dependencies in the handoff before coding; no unsupported helper is presumed available. Add missing route, cross-boundary conservation and deposit handling in that same handoff. Encode validation and execution rules in code with tests for conservation, repeated invocation, interruption, cancellation, death, competing work and blocked routes; no repeated model adjudication. Development/review waiting advances no world time and approval does not perform study or move matter.
